classification: pending root strategic review; no source finding classified here
scope: Minimal Evolution inventory observation guard and adapter unit coverage; accompanying product-path obligations remain gated by a separate already-admitted caller recovery repair.
authority: Preparation-only delegation. This proposal grants no implementation authority. Approved TODO and CP1 sources remain frozen during the validator and independent review.
observed_issue: consultarInstancia currently maps successful non-array JSON to an empty array. chamar() maps successful JSON parse failures to {}. Thus invalid object/null/string or invalid JSON becomes null (apparent absence); cleanup callers may then mark CLEANED. This behavior predates the Instagram feature and is not asserted as a new regression or classified as a defect in this proposal.

proposed_behavior.valid_absence: Conclusive absence requires a fully validated inventory without the exact target name: [] and valid nonmatching rows both qualify.
proposed_behavior.malformed_or_ambiguous: Non-array payloads, invalid JSON (normalized to {} by current transport helper), malformed rows/optional fields, and duplicate exact target names throw the existing safe EvolutionIndisponivelError.
proposed_behavior.known_observation: A unique exact-name row retains the existing projection: name plus ownerJid and connectionStatus as string or null.
proposed_behavior.transport_and_scope: No new HTTP call or probing path. No change to status/transport outcomes, sends, auth, URLs, secrets, timeouts, or signatures. No fallback is introduced.

unit_cases_in_proposed_diff: invalid JSON rejects after existing {} normalization
unique matching row with omitted optional fields preserves null projection
unique matching row with null optional fields preserves null projection
unique matching row with populated optional fields preserves exact projection
all new observation cases assert exactly one fetch; every existing spec assertion remains in place
required_product_path_regression_case_if: Through the actual authenticated BFF/service path and real PostgreSQL fixture in api-app/test/instagram-lifecycle.e2e-spec.ts, exercise WhatsApp/Evolution pairing/renewal lifecycle. Mandatory proof A: retained-renewal cleanup with a managed prior identity in CLEANUP_PENDING, followed by malformed successful inventory and invalid-JSON observation; assert cleanup remains ambiguous, prior identity stays CLEANUP_PENDING, and no new create or unconfirmed deletion effect occurs. Then return either fully validated inventory without the exact target (including [] or valid nonmatching rows) or an exact deletion response explicitly confirming deletion; continue through the required caller recovery transition and assert explicit eventual recovery using the same reservation, generation, pairing epoch, and attempt, with exactly one replacement create. Mandatory proof B: post-unlink cleanup recovery through the same malformed observation, preserved CLEANUP_PENDING/zero new create or unconfirmed-delete effects, then validated absence or exact confirmed deletion and explicit eventual recovery. Both reachable cleanup paths are mandatory, not conditional. The separate IG-EVOCOMP-01 caller repair is a prerequisite and is not fixed/proved here. No parallel HTTP/domain path.
